items.evidence: play --ticks 1 printed {tick:1, screen:title, menu_index, language, volume, difficulty, texts, score, best, coins, wave, gate_health, guard_y, quick, heavy, saved, enemies, bolts}: every key the brief names.
play ... --frame f_play.png --size 800x480 (and the README's own frame command) wrote a PNG whose IHDR reads 800 x 480.
Fresh title texts: ['Hold the gate: the long night','Best: 0','Start','Settings','Quit'] (no Continue); 2:enter -> tick 3 screen play, wave 1, score 0, coins 0, gate_health 10.

Settings: right x3 from 8 gives 10 and stays 10; left x10 gives 0 and stays 0; language en->es->fr and stops at fr; difficulty normal (default) -> hard stops at hard, left -> normal -> easy stops at easy.

With es and fr kept settings, texts on title (with Continue), settings, play, shop, paused, won and lost were all translated (e.g. 'Tienda','Manos rapidas: nivel 0 de 2, 5 monedas'; 'Vous avez gagne','Entree : titre'); only the game's name stays English.
Run 1 with --settings s1 set volume 10, Spanish, hard; run 2 on s1 started with language es, volume 10, difficulty hard (title 'Mejor: 0','Empezar'); a fresh folder starts en, 8, normal.
Up held from tick 10: guard_y 6 -> 9 at tick 40 (0.1/tick = 6 u/s), stops at 12; down holds at 0.
Shoot held at guard_y 0: new bolts at ticks 71, 95, 119 (24 apart); bolt x grows 0.2333/tick (14 u/s); never more than 3-4 bolts, none past x 20.
Wave 1 (seed 1): 5 walkers spawned at ticks 3, 93, 183, 273, 363 (90 apart) in lanes 2,4,8,6,6, health 2, x falling 0.025/tick (1.5 u/s).
Guard at y 2: first bolt left the y=2 walker at health 1 and vanished; second destroyed it, score 0->10, coins 0->1; a bolt at y 2.8 flew past the y=4 walker.

No input: each walker reaching x<=0 vanished and took 1 from the gate with score/coins unchanged; Hard run reached gate 0 at tick 9825: screen lost, texts ['You lost','Score: 0','Best: 1,620','Enter: title'].
Easy set in Settings then Start: gate_health 14; Hard: gate_health 7 (texts 'Gate: 7').

After the last wave-1 walker: screen shop, texts ['Shop','Coins: 5','Next: wave 2 of 8','Quick hands: level 0 of 2, 5 coins','Heavy bolts: level 0 of 1, 12 coins','Mason: gate +3 health, 4 coins','Next wave']; holding up/shoot there changed guard_y and bolts not at all; escape did nothing.
Quick 1 (wave 2): held shoot fired at ticks 471, 489, 507, 525 (18); quick 2 (wave 5): 2782, 2794, 2806, ... (12); at quick 2 with 18 coins Enter on it left coins 18 and quick 2 ('done').
Heavy bought for 12 (coins 17->5); in wave 4 every walker went from health 2 straight to gone with one bolt, brute went 6->4->2; second Enter on Heavy with 18 coins changed nothing.
Gate 11, coins 13: Mason -> 14, coins 9; further Enters at 14: no change. Gate 12, coins 10: Mason -> 14 (capped), coins 6. Gate 12, coins 3: Enter on Mason changed nothing.
Next wave entered at tick 515 -> first walker at x 20 at tick 575 (60 later), none at 574; wave 2 spawned 7 walkers; play texts 'Wave 2 of 8' ('Oleada 2 de 8', 'Vague 2 sur 8').
Wave 3 (sampled every 2 ticks): 6 walkers then 4 runners, spawns 72 ticks apart; runners health 1, speed 3.0 u/s; each runner kill score +15, coins +1.
Wave 4: 8 walkers then 1 brute (health 6, speed 1.0); killed: score 320->360, coins 13->16; left alone it reached the gate: 14 -> 11 with no points.
modules/work/waves.json holds walkers/runners/brutes/every for each of the 8 waves, read by lib.rs (wave_plan); README 'Change a wave' says to edit it. The real spawns matched the table.
Scripted Easy run of all 8 waves (seed 1): tick 6484 screen won, score 1300->1620 = 1340 points from kills + 20 x 14 gate; Enter at 6490 -> title.
Escape at 100: enemies and bolts identical at 101, 150, 200 (up held did not move guard); Enter on Resume: they move on from the same values; Title from pause -> title screen.

saved becomes true when the shop opens, but a second play run on the same --settings folder shows saved false and title ['...','Best: 0','Start','Settings','Quit'] with no Continue. README admits the saved run is not kept between runs.

Within one run: Quick hands bought in shop 1, Next wave, pause, Title, Continue -> shop with wave 1, score 50, coins 0, gate 14, quick 1 ('level 1 of 2'); Next wave -> wave 2, first walker 60 ticks later. (Across runs Continue never appears: see l23.)
Within one run: Title from pause left saved true with Continue shown; Start then set saved false and the next pause->Title showed no Continue; lost and won screens both showed saved false.

In one run the won run set Best 1,620 on title/won screen and a later lost run with 0 left it 1,620 (shown on lost screen); but a later headless run on the same settings folder shows best 0 / 'Best: 0': the best score is not kept.
Two runs seed 7, same inputs, each from its own copy of one settings folder: outputs byte-identical (cmp). Wave 1 lanes: seed 1 [2,4,8,6,6], seed 2 [4,8,4,2,8], seed 3 [4,2,10,2,10].

Frame at tick 6200 (wave 8): grey gate strip at x 0, blue guard at (2,8), green walkers, small orange runners, large red brute at x 19.7, three thin bolts at y 8: all at the state's positions (40 px/unit); HUD 'Score: 1,070 Coins: 61 Wave 8 of 8 Gate: 13'.
Spanish frames: title with 'Ajustes' outlined (menu_index 1), settings with 'Idioma: Espanol' outlined, shop with 'Albanil: puerta +3 de salud, 4 monedas' outlined; all texts in Spanish.
assets/strings/en.json, es.json, fr.json are key->string tables; the UI uses @keys; README 'Add a language' says to copy en.json to <code>.json and translate.

README covers how to play, where things are kept (settings in --settings folder; says plainly that best and saved run are not kept), and its headless-run and frame commands both ran as written and printed state / wrote an 800x480 frame.

defects: The best score and the saved run live only in the process: a new headless run (or a restarted game) always starts with best 0 and no saved run, against the brief's 'kept' requirement.
On the title screen the report still carries the last run's score, coins, wave and gate_health (e.g. score 1620, gate_health 14 on the title), not cleared values.
